message.content:
For a positive integer to have exactly 3 digits in base \(5\), it must satisfy  
\[
5^2 \le n \le 5^3-1
\]
so
\[
25 \le n \le 124.
\]

For it to have exactly 2 digits in base \(8\), it must satisfy  
\[
8^1 \le n \le 8^2-1
\]
so
\[
8 \le n \le 63.
\]

The integers satisfying both conditions are  
\[
25 \le n \le 63.
\]

These form an arithmetic sequence from \(25\) to \(63\). Its average is  
\[
\frac{25+63}{2}=44.
\]

The answer is 44.
